# Study 6 — Tülu-3-8B with the Study 4 arm-A protocol: summary (generated by scripts/study6_analyze.py)

Tülu-3-8B, the authors' prompt in Tülu's chat format, layer 2, α 5, sentence-words-only push, vectors recomputed from Tülu; 20 fresh draws × 10 positions.

Sanity: **PASS**; S7 clean copies exact: 20/20.

## Injection size (plan §4)

Average residual norm at the injection point (sentence words): Tülu 2.322, Llama 2.287. Push size 5 = 215.4% of Tülu's normal size vs 218.6% of Llama's. Ratio Tülu ÷ Llama = **0.985**.

Cosine, Tülu vectors vs the authors' Llama vectors: mean **0.5308** (range 0.0691 to 0.9963).
